kibble.bundle.comic: {0} files will be zipped into one comic and queued as a single post.
kibble.bundle.separate: {0} files will be queued as they are, in the order shown, each posting on its own.
kibble.cbznote: Saved as .cbz. The number on each tile is the page it will be.
kibble.description: Fills the posting bot's queues. Open a folder, go through it, and send each file to a group.
kibble.dry.detail: {0}. The bot will re-post from the archive instead of new material.
kibble.duplicates.hint: A file this group already has, queued or posted, goes to its Duplicates folder instead of being refused. The bot never looks in there.
kibble.empty: Nothing here. Open a folder to start, or you have cleared it out, which is the idea.
kibble.error.nobot: Could not find the posting bot. Pick its folder.
kibble.inbatches.tip: Build only a batch of tiles at a time. Much faster on a folder of thousands.
kibble.keys: Press 1 to 9 to send, space to skip. Ctrl click or shift click to pick several.
kibble.movenote: Files move rather than copy. Undo puts the last one back where it came from.
kibble.naming.randomtag: Folder name plus a random tag
kibble.nopreview: No inline preview for this file type
kibble.pageorder.aspicked: Pages in the order I picked them
kibble.refuse.duplicate.posted: already posted to this group, as {0}.
kibble.refuse.duplicate.queued: already in this group's queue, as {0}.
kibble.refuse.emptycomic: No postable pages inside this archive, so sending it would fail.
kibble.refuse.minbundle: Pick at least {0} files to make a comic.
kibble.refuse.notacomicpage: {0} cannot be a comic page. A media group takes photos and videos only, so gifs, pdfs and archives have to be sent on their own.
kibble.refuse.notpostable: The bot does not recognise this extension, so it would sit in the queue being skipped.
kibble.refuse.readback: The archive read back with {0} of {1} pages, so nothing was queued.
kibble.separatenote: They go in one by one, in the order the grid is showing, so the sort above decides it.
kibble.stamp.hint.keep: Files keep their original date, so genuinely older art posts first.
kibble.stamp.hint.queued: Files are stamped as they are queued, so it is first in, first out.
kibble.stamp.queued: Date them as they are queued
kibble.status.duplicate: Already in {0}, so it went to Duplicates
